title: District 6 Lights Up North Central Park for 12th Annual 'Light the Way for Christmas' Dec. 3
excerpt: The City of Laredo and District 6 Council Member Dr. Tyler King invite families to North Central Park on Thursday, Dec. 3, from 5 to 8 p.m. for the 12th annual holiday celebration, with the Christmas tree lighting at 6:45 p.m.
content:
North Central Park is getting its Christmas lights on Thursday, Dec. 3, as the City of Laredo and District 6 Council Member Dr. Tyler King host the 12th Annual Light the Way for Christmas.

The free family celebration runs from 5 to 8 p.m. at North Central Park, 10202 International Blvd. School choirs and dance and band performances are on the program, along with local vendors, train rides, Santa's sleigh, and an appearance by the Grinch on the Christmas trolley.

Hot chocolate and Christmas cookies will be served free while supplies last. The evening's centerpiece, the Christmas tree lighting, is scheduled for 6:45 p.m.

The city announced the event on Sunday, Nov. 22. Families are encouraged to bundle up and arrive early for the countdown to the lighting.

Source: City of Laredo - Government, Nov. 22, 2026.
